name: FPV Quadcopter Drone
summary: Flyable FPV quadcopter with Acro and Angle flight modes, an OSD and a detonating payload.
description: Flyable FPV quadcopter drone (beta) with Acro and Angle modes, an arming key, tunable rates, a Betaflight-style OSD and a payload set off by the player. AI does not work and ground collision is unreliable. Open source under GPL-3.0.

releases.changelog: Ground collision adjusted, more visible to AI, OSD improvements, VR camera fix.
